WITH RECURSIVE paged_roots AS ( SELECT post_id, CASE WHEN notice_yn = 'Y' AND (notice_start_dt IS NULL OR notice_start_dt = '' OR notice_start_dt <= TO_CHAR(NOW(),'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND (notice_end_dt IS NULL OR notice_end_dt = '' OR notice_end_dt >= TO_CHAR(NOW(),'YYYY-MM-DD')) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS notice_eff FROM post WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND p_post_id = 0 AND board_id = #{boardId}::integer AND NOT EXISTS ( -- 내가 차단한 회원의 글은 내 목록에서 제외 SELECT 1 FROM member_block ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = post.reg_id ) AND title LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%' ORDER BY notice_eff DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset} ), thread AS ( SELECT b.post_id, b.p_post_id, 0 AS lvl, pr.notice_eff AS root_notice, b.post_id AS root_id, ARRAY[b.post_id] AS path FROM post b JOIN paged_roots pr ON pr.post_id = b.post_id UNION ALL SELECT c.post_id, c.p_post_id, t.lvl + 1, t.root_notice, t.root_id, t.path || c.post_id FROM post c JOIN thread t ON c.p_post_id = t.post_id WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' )
SELECT b.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.board_id, b.title, b.notice_yn, b.secret_yn, b.view_cnt, b.good_cnt, t.lvl AS depth, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.handle FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN #{viewerId}::text IS NOT NULL AND b.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file tf ON tf.file_id = r.file_id AND tf.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = b.post_id AND r.file_type = 'POST_IMG' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = b.post_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, CASE WHEN t.lvl = 0 THEN t.root_notice ELSE 'N' END AS notice_eff FROM thread t JOIN post b ON b.post_id = t.post_id ORDER BY t.root_notice DESC, t.root_id DESC, t.path

SELECT b.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.board_id, b.title, b.view_cnt, bi.name AS board_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = b.post_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM post b LEFT JOIN board bi ON bi.board_id = b.board_id WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_post_id = 0 AND b.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY b.post_id DESC LIMIT 50 -- 커밋

SELECT b.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.board_id, b.title, b.view_cnt, b.good_cnt, bi.name AS board_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = b.post_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.profile_file_id::TEXT FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM post b JOIN board bi ON bi.board_id = b.board_id JOIN hobby h ON h.board_id = b.board_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_post_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND b.reg_dt >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY (COALESCE(b.good_cnt,0) * 3 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = b.post_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') * 2 + COALESCE(b.view_cnt,0) * 0.1) DESC, b.post_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.board_id, b.title, b.view_cnt, b.good_cnt, bi.name AS board_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment cm WHERE cm.post_id = b.post_id AND cm.use_yn = 'Y') AS comment_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM post b JOIN board bi ON bi.board_id = b.board_id JOIN hobby h ON h.board_id = b.board_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_post_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND b.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY b.post_id DESC LIMIT 20

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_block ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = post.reg_id )

SELECT post_id::TEXT AS row_id, board_id, title, content, p_post_id, depth, sort_no, secret_yn, password, good_cnt, bad_cnt, view_cnt, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_like l WHERE l.target_type = 'POST' AND l.target_id = post.post_id AND l.member_id = #{viewerId}) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS liked_yn, notice_yn, notice_start_dt, notice_end_dt, reg_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = post.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.handle FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = post.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN #{viewerId}::text IS NOT NULL AND reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = post.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM post WHERE post_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (board_id, title, content, p_post_id, depth, sort_no, secret_yn, password, good_cnt, bad_cnt, view_cnt, notice_yn, notice_start_dt, notice_end_dt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{boardId}::integer, #{title}, #{content}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pPostId}, '')::integer, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{depth}, '')::integer, 1), (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) + 1 FROM post WHERE board_id = #{boardId}::integer), COALESCE(#{secretYn}, 'N'), NULLIF(#{password}, ''), 0, 0, 0, COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), NULLIF(#{noticeStartDt}, ''), NULLIF(#{noticeEndDt}, ''), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, secret_yn = COALESCE(#{secretYn}, 'N'), password = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{password}, ''), password), notice_yn = COALESCE(#{noticeYn}, 'N'), notice_start_dt = NULLIF(#{noticeStartDt}, ''), notice_end_dt = NULLIF(#{noticeEndDt}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE post_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE post SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE post_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE post SET view_cnt = COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE post_id = #{rowId}::integer
